AN order to provide for the services during the four months from 01st January, 2025 to 30th April, 2025, to authorize the raising of loans within the province of Sabaragamuwa for the purpose of such service, to make fi nancial provisions in respect of certain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during that four months, to enable the payment, by way of advances out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of, or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund, and to make provision for matters connected with or incidental to the aforesaid matter.
BE it enacted by me, the Governor of the Sabaragamuwa Province of the Democratic Socialist Rebuplic of Sri Lanka as Follows.

1. I do hereby grant permission unto the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Officers of the Province to spend Rupees Twenty One Billion Seventeen Million Five Hundred Th ousand only, (Rs. 21,017,500,000 /-) and which estimated for the services of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the four months duration beginning on 01st January, 2025 and ending on 30th April, 2025,

by virtue of powers vested in me under section 27(A) of Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987 as the term of the Sixth Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council ended on 26th September, 2017.

2. (1). Without prejudice to any other law authorizing any expenditure of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which estimate will be Rupees Twenty One Billion Seventeen Million Five Hundred Th ousand only, (Rs. 21,017,500,000/-) for the service of the period beginning on 01st January 2025 and ending on 30th April, 2025, in this order referred to as the “four months duration” shall be met.
(a). For payments which are hereby authorized to be made out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or monies of or advance at the disposal of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council and,

(b). For the proceeds of loans which are hereby authorized to be raised, within the province of Sabaragamuwa for and on behalf of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. Th e sum of Rupees Twenty One Billion Seventeen Million Five Hundred Th ousand only, (Rs. 21,017,500,000/-) here in before referred to may be duly expended as specifi ed in the fi rst schedule to this order.

(2). Th e provision of subsection (1) of this section shall have eff ect without prejudice to the provisions of any other written law authorizing the raising of loans for and on behalf of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.

3. (1). Th e receipts of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council during the fi rst four months of the fi nancial year, 2025 from each activity specifi ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall be credited to the account of such activity, the aggregate of receipts so credited shall be not less than the minimum limit specifi ed in the corresponding entry in column (vi) of that schedule .

4. Th e expenditure incurred by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, during the fi rst four months of the fi nancial year 2020 each activity specifi ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall be paid out of the receipt of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council from such expenditure shall not exceed the maximum limit specifi ed in the corresponding entry in column (v) of that schedule.

5. Th e debit balance, outstanding at the end of fi rst four months duration of the fi nancial year 2025 of any activity specifi ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order shall not exceed the maximum limit specifi ed in the corresponding entry in column (vii) of that schedule, and the total liabilities of that activity at the end of that fi nancial year shall not exceed the maximum limit specifi ed in the corresponding entry column (viii) of that schedule.
Appropriation for the fi rst four months of 2025
Financial provision in respect of certain activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the fi rst four monhs of the years 2025

6. Whenever at any time during fi rst four months of the fi nancial year 2025, the receipts of that Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council from any activity specifi ed in column (iv) of the second schedule to this order are insuffi cient to meet the expenditure incurred by the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council on such activity, the minister may, from time to time, by order direct that such sums may deem necessary to meet such expenditure shall be payable by way of advances out of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of, the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, so however that the aggregate of the sums so advances does not exceed the maximum limit of entry in column (v) of that schedule. Any sums so advanced in respect of such activity shall be refunded to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund in such manner as the Governor may by order direct.

7. (1). Any money which, by virtue of the provisions of the fi rst schedule to this order, have been allocated to recurrent expenditure under any programme appearing under any head specifi ed in that schedule but have not been expended or may likely to be unexpended, may be transferred to the allocation of recurrent expenditure or capital expenditure under any other programme within that head by order of the Chief Secretary to the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or any other offi cer authorized by him.

(2). Any money allocated to capital expenditure under any programme appearing under any head specifi ed in the fi rst schedule to this order shall be transferred out of that programme or project only by the Chief Secretary of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
8. (1). Th at the receipts from taxes and other sources will be less than the amount anticipated to fi nance authorized expenditure. or;
(2). Th at amount originally appropriated for a particular purpose or purposes are no longer required;

He may with the approval of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council, withdraw in whole, or in part, any amounts previously released for expenditure under the authority of a warrant issued by him from the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council fund or from any other fund or monies of or at the disposal of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council.
9. Th e Governor may, on or before 31st May, 2026, by order, vary or alter.
(a). Any of the maximum limits specifi ed in column (v), column (vii) and column (viii) of the second schedule to this order.
(b). Th e maximum limits specifi ed in column (vi) of the second schedule to this order.
No order made under this section shall have eff ect unless it has been approved by the Governor.
Any such order shall, if so expressed therein be deemed to have had eff ect from such date prior to the date of making such order as may be specifi ed therein.
Advance payments out of Provincial Council fund or any other fund for the activities mentioned in the paragraph 3 during the fi rst four months of the year 2025.
Power to transfer unexpected monies allocated to recurrent expenditure to another allocation within some programme or to another programme under the same head of expenditure
Power of Governor to vary the maximum and minimum limits specifi ed in the second schedule to this order

(b). Th e minimum limit relating to such activity.

11. Th is permission will be valid till 30th day of April 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs fi rst.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to spend a sum of Rupees Twenty One Billion Seventeen Million Five Hundred Thousand Only, (Rs. 21,017,500,000/-) out of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council Fund, which is estimated for the expenses of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the four months period that starts on 01st of January, 2025 and end on 30th April, 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017.

This permission will be valid till 30th April, 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-starts the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.

Since the Provincial Council has not yet received the details of the Tresury grants and the revenue targets required to prepare the Annual Financial Statement and Revenue and Expenditure Estimates for the year 2025, this estimate has been prepared in the form of vote on account. As these estimates have been prepared in the expectation that the grants and revenue targets for these expenses will be provided by the Treasury in the future, I limit this authorization to incur expenses only upto the maximum of the revenue collected and provided by the Treasury for the ﬁ rst four months of the year 2025. A.A.C.J. Rൺඃൺඋൺඍඇൾ, Hon. Governor, Sabaragamuwa Province. 29th day of December, 2024.

I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses stated in the Second (II) Schedule, which is estimated for the Advance Account Activities of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council for the four months period that starts on 01st of January, 2025 and end on 30th April, 2025, by virtue of powers vested in me under Section 27 (a) of the Provincial Council Act No. 42 of 1987, as the term of the 06th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ended on 26th September, 2017. Accordingly, I do hereby grant permission to the Chief Secretary and the Accounting Oﬃ cers of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council to bear the expenses subject to those limits.

This permission will be valid till 30th December, 2025 or upto the date that expires 03 months from the date of summoning the 07th Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council or from the date re-start the functions of the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council which occurs ﬁ rst.
